title: Broncos re-sign RB Jaleel McLaughlin with a one-year deal

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos re-sign RB Jaleel McLaughlin with a one-year deal
sources.description: According to NFL Network’s lead league insider Ian Rapoport, the Denver Broncos have re-signed running back Jaleel McLaughlin to a one-year deal. It’s another vet minimum deal that will be worth $1.145 million dollars. The Broncos have been re-signing pretty much all of their free agents, so it made sense that running back Jaleel McLaughlin […]
